text.tspan: WHAT CHANGED vs R37: (1) staff WC added at grid 4–5 / E per your sketch — 2 urinals behind grid 5, 2 WC stacked, basin counter on the east wall, door from
the aisle; lease units L1/L2 shrink to 2.50 m each (24.5 m² together).
(2) S1 STAIR FIXED — same footprint (x −1.80…3.20, y 30.10…32.80): U-stair, 2 flights × 10 risers 0.175 = 3.50, treads 0.26, width 1.20, mid-landing +1.75
at the west end. Route: passage → north door → walk east under the upper flight
(headroom ≥ 2.25 m at the passage, ≥ 3.3 m under the top landing) → turn north to START → flight 1 west → landing +1.75 → flight 2 east → top landing +3.50
sits on the L2 slab edge (y 30.10). Pool store (≈3.0 m², 1.55 m high) under the mid-landing.
DRAINS: all F/M/staff urinals and showers are behind grid 5. The staff WC pans (like your sketch) and the accessible WC pan are in front of grid 5 → their
drains must run through/under the existing floor — please confirm this is OK.
RENTABLE: L1 + L2 24.5 + gift shop 13.7 + kiosk 4.1 ≈ 42 m² (R37 52 m², the difference is the staff WC). Still to check: fire exits, exhaust fans for windowless
